name: Custom Shape 2-Layer Wooden And Acrylic Suncatcher Hanging Pieces Wind Chime With Crystal Charm
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Main Piece: Premium 2-layer structure combining 3mm clear acrylic (layer 1) and 3mm natural wood on top (layer 2).
    - Hanging Piece: High-quality clear acrylic  (3 mm thickness), laser-cut for precision and durability.
    - The Main Piece and Hanging Piece are connected by a short metal chain, allowing gentle movement and adding a charming layered visual effect when displayed.

 

  • Crystal Charm Options:
    This product offers two elegant crystal charm options, allowing customers to personalize the look:
    - Round Crystal Charm – A classic faceted sphere that reflects light beautifully, creating a sparkling, elegant effect.
    - Heart Crystal Charm – A faceted heart-shaped crystal that adds a romantic and sentimental touch.
    Both crystal charms are securely attached with a metal connector and are designed to catch sunlight, enhancing the overall visual appeal of the hanging ornament or wind chime.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Main Piece (WxH):
    3 × 3 inches ~ 7.62 × 7.62 cm
    4 × 4 inches ~ 10.16 × 10.16 cm
    5 × 5 inches ~ 12.7 × 12.7 cm
    - Hanging Piece: Matches the selected size of the main piece for a balanced visual appearance.
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed. Sizes may vary slightly depending on the chosen custom shape.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - UV printing technology for vibrant colors, sharp details, and excellent durability.
    - Main piece: Printed on 1 side to maximize the holographic light effect.
    - Hanging piece: Printed on both sides, ensuring the design looks beautiful from any viewing angle.

 

  • Function & Usage:
    - Designed as a decorative suncatcher, reflecting and refracting sunlight to create a glowing, stained-glass–like effect.
    - Can be hung on windows, doors, balconies, walls, or combined with wind chimes for added movement and sound.
    - Ideal for home décor, memorial displays, or personalized keepsakes featuring names, messages, or meaningful artwork.

 

  • Gift Idea for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful and meaningful gift for everyone, suitable for any occasion, including birthdays, Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, anniversaries, housewarmings, holidays, or remembrance moments.
    - Perfect for gifting to moms, family members, friends, or loved ones who appreciate personalized décor and heartfelt designs.

 

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x Custom Shape 2-Layer Wooden And Acrylic Suncatcher Hanging Pieces Wind Chime With Crystal Charm

 

PRODUCTION

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
